mentions.name: Screenleash
mentions.description: A screen time enforcement tool that deducts money from the user's bank account when time spent on specific websites exceeds an allocated limit, using financial penalties to curb usage of distracting sites and games.
mentions.problem: The author was addicted to playing Smashkarts over 2 hours per day and wanted to cut down time spent on distracting websites; usage is now capped at 30 minutes.
mentions.audience: A personal-use project by the author for their own screen time control.
mentions.source_excerpt: Screenleash.com: A personal project that deducts money from my bank if I spend more than the allocated time on specific websites.

evidence.value: Screenleash.com: A personal project that deducts money from my bank if I spend more than the allocated time on specific websites.
